The Roubic Shaker Heights Story

Heritage-Canopy Work in Shaker Heights

Shaker Heights is a historic planned community in Cuyahoga County — one of the earliest planned suburbs in the country, famous for its tree-lined streets and mature heritage canopy of oak, maple, and sycamore. The trees that make Shaker Heights look like Shaker Heights are exactly the trees Roubic works on.

The context matters here: distinctive architectural streetscapes, large mature lots, conservation-minded neighborhoods, and an active City Tree Commission. Roubic operates the way that setting demands — owner-supervised jobs, ANSI A300 pruning standards, a strict oak-wilt seasonal calendar, and a full owned equipment fleet including crane-assist for large heritage trees.

The trees that make Shaker Heights look like Shaker Heights are the ones we're protecting. The tree care has to fit the place. {{global.owner_name}} · Owner

Common Shaker Heights Questions

Shaker Heights Tree Service FAQ

Six things Shaker Heights homeowners want to know before booking.

Do you serve Shaker Heights, OH?
Yes — Shaker Heights is part of Roubic Tree & Landscape's Tier 2 service area, 14 miles from our Auburn Township yard. We're a family-owned NE Ohio tree service, in business since 1982. Call {{global.phone}} for a free estimate.
How quickly do you respond in Shaker Heights?
Tier 2 markets like Shaker Heights receive next-day response on standard work and a 2–4 hour target on emergencies from our Auburn Township yard. For 24/7 storm emergencies, call our emergency line — a real person answers and the crew dispatches immediately.
Do I need a tree-removal permit in Shaker Heights?
Shaker Heights has an active City Tree Commission and a tree-protection ordinance that requires a permit to remove protected trees above a specified DBH threshold, with ROW review for work near city-owned trees. Hazard trees follow an expedited process. Roubic routinely handles the permit workflow as part of the job.
How much does tree removal cost in Shaker Heights?
Tree removal in Shaker Heights typically runs $200–$10,000+ depending on tree size, species, access, and permit fees. Small trees under 20 ft start around $200–$500; mature 50–80 ft trees run $1,500–$3,500; very large heritage estate trees needing crane assistance can exceed $10,000. Every estimate is free and quoted on-site.
Can you work on our heritage oaks and mature trees?
Yes — heritage canopy is Roubic's specialty. We prune to ANSI A300 standards, follow a strict oak-wilt seasonal calendar (no oak work April 1 through July 31), and run crane-assist for large estate trees. Owner-supervised jobs with a full owned equipment fleet — no subcontracting.
